verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships OpenCode and Claude Code as default agents and invites users to set one up on first boot to "put it to work on your computer." The omarchy CLI is explicitly pitched as a way for an AI agent to handle customization and configuration. Bundled skills let users describe the apps, plugins, or themes they want, and crash notifications can hand the problem to the agent. Missing for 10: natural-language operation runs through third-party agent harnesses that need sign-in rather than a native command interface; no documentation of how much of the system the agent can reliably control; no independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
